answers.text/5601: Looks like your vampire blood saved you this time.
answers.text/5602: I never thought it would come to this...
answers.text/5605: You've lost some of your memory, it seems...
answers.text/5607: We fought the Immortals together. You haven't forgotten me, too?
answers.text/5608: I'm Otenko, messenger of the Sun.
answers.text/5610: First, we have to get out of this dungeon.
answers.text/5613: <PROC=1>The LIFE gauge at the top left shows your health.
answers.text/5614: When an enemy hurts you, your LIFE drops.
answers.text/5615: If it reaches zero, it's game over.
answers.text/5616: The ENE gauge below LIFE shows your spirit energy.
answers.text/5617: Your weapon, the Gun Del Sol, runs on magic...
answers.text/5619: We'll have to find somewhere to recharge...
